title: 奖励和商店界面按顶部资源栏确认源石锭
method: Scanned the complete 981.833 s local normal-play recording in 1964 half-second samples. A fixed video-only icon locator shortlisted the visible slot; manually reviewed the 81 distinct candidate digit-mask representatives and scene contacts. 475 sampled slots were visibly readable. Count a change only for a different value observed at two successive sample times; hidden content, first observation and shorter transients excluded. This is not an exhaustive frame-level transaction count.
implementation: Bind OCR numbers and icon centers to the current life-label header. Check the two intermediate icon scales only when all original scale samples miss, preserving the .91 threshold. A verified resource HUD can qualify on other center-screen views including rewards and shop; no inference about page type or spending. Prices below the header cannot displace the header amount. Emit a confirmed gold read before additional HUD counters finish.

native_replay.scope: Real client crops and selected preceding reference frames from the recording, injected through the production capture buffer in chronological order into an isolated native inventory panel. Each test clock begins with injection of the sampled crop and ends at a Paint showing the new value. Two sampling strategies applied separately to the same 15 observed changes, not 30 independent events. User panel visibility in the original session, physical display scanout, exact onset between samples, game FPS and live p95 not measured.

accuracy_scope: Three midpoint frames lack a qualifying full-OCR numeric box; four misses at the first sampled frame. Leave missing readings unconfirmed. Intermediate amount animations may be shorter than the audit cadence.

icon_cost.scope: 17 identical real recorded frames with their OCR texts. Gold/parts reader only, engine omitted, four alternating timing pairs after the counted call; no end-to-end speedup inferred.

verified.comparison: Equal complete observations excluding read timing, observed timestamp and intended gold additions. Existing confirmed gold values preserved on these pairs.
verified.startup: Original product window closed normally; updated native toolbar visible and responding. No game input and no new recording.

not_adopted: Longer-lived glyph dictionaries, including an independent glyph OCR check, gave no additional opportunity in the near-change sequence windows versus the previous confirmed glyph mechanism. Removed the prototype and retained the original exact shape criteria.
next: Improve qualified capture of small single-digit header text on reward/shop animations and re-evaluate actual change coverage and game resource use. No private recording or session payload published.
